elements.label: NCWd: colour word in another ink

tasks.description: **Experiment 2, colour naming by key.** Each item of Stroop's 100-item sheets is one trial: a fixation point for [[param:fixation_duration]], then a solid colour square (NC) or a colour word printed in another colour's ink (NCWd) at the centre. The subject presses the key for the **ink**. A wrong key leaves the item up until the right key (Stroop's self-correction), up to [[param:response_timeout]]. A session is four sheets in order A (control, interference, interference, control) or B (the reverse), with practice items first; items are served in sheet order, not shuffled. Keys replace the paper's spoken responses (a deviation).
notes: Fixation 500 ms, deadline 5000 ms and blank 500 ms are ASSUMED; the paper's sheets were read continuously.
Keys D F J K L = red blue green brown purple are ASSUMED; responses were spoken in the paper (deviation).

Inks drawn from the parameter file: red #ff0000, blue #0000ff, green #008000, brown #804000, purple #8000a0, black #000000 on page #e6e6e6. RGB values, 0.7° Arial and 0.75° squares are ASSUMED; the paper used 14-point Franklin type (deviation).
UNCORRECTED items are charged twice the sheet's mean time per item in the analysis (paper p. 17).
WRONG occurs only if require_correction is false; the shipped sets keep it true.
Block order by subject number and form sequence 1, 2, 1, 2 are ASSUMED.
